# Optional PhotoRec

Download TestDisk/PhotoRec 7.2 for Windows from https://www.cgsecurity.org/wiki/TestDisk_Download .
Extract the **whole** official package, retaining DLLs and license notices, to:

`vendor/testdisk-7.2/photorec_win.exe`

This repository does not download or install it automatically. Never put recovery output in vendor.
For a different upstream version, review and adapt app.py before use; only the 7.2 command invocation has been exercised locally.
